measures.title: Sales and Use Tax for Mental Health or Chemical Dependency Treatment or Therapeutic Courts
measures.summary: An advisory vote called by the Grant County Board of Commissioners on whether the county should adopt a sales and use tax of one-tenth of one percent (0.1%) under RCW 82.14.460. Revenue would be used only for chemical dependency and mental health treatment programs and services and for therapeutic court programs. The measure is advisory and does not itself impose a tax; the Board may consider the result in deciding whether to adopt the tax.
measures.yesMeans: You advise the Board of Commissioners that the 0.1% sales and use tax for treatment and therapeutic courts should be adopted.
measures.noMeans: You advise the Board of Commissioners that the 0.1% sales and use tax should not be adopted.

measures.title: Public Safety Sales and Use Tax
measures.summary: Under Resolution No. 4042, the City of Moses Lake asks to raise its sales and use tax by one-tenth of one percent (0.1%, one cent per $10 sale) under RCW 82.14.450. Revenue would fund public safety services, including law enforcement staffing and retention, public safety operations, maintenance and capital, and other criminal justice city services. The explanatory statement estimates about $1.2 million in 2027.
measures.yesMeans: Moses Lake's sales and use tax would increase by 0.1% to fund public safety services.
measures.noMeans: Moses Lake's sales and use tax would not increase for this purpose.
